@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+# SYNTAX TEST "source.rian" "Rian grammar assertions"
+
+# a line comment
+# <- comment.line.number-sign.rian
+
+def f(x Int64) Bool := true
+# <- keyword.declaration.function.rian
+#   ^ entity.name.function.rian
+#       ^^^^^ entity.name.type.rian
+#                   ^^ keyword.operator.assignment.rian
+#                      ^^^^ constant.language.boolean.rian
+
+type Shape := Circle(radius Float64) | Square(side Float64)
+# <- keyword.declaration.type.rian
+#    ^^^^^ entity.name.type.rian
+#          ^^ keyword.operator.assignment.rian
+#             ^^^^^^ entity.name.type.rian
+#                                    ^ keyword.operator.other.rian
+
+def area(s val Shape) Float64 := s
+#          ^^^ storage.modifier.capability.rian
+
+def pipe(name String) String := name |> upcase
+#                                    ^^ keyword.operator.pipe.rian
+
+def concat(a String) String := a <> "hi\n"
+#                                ^^ keyword.operator.concat.rian
+#                                   ^ string.quoted.double.rian
+#                                      ^^ constant.character.escape.rian
+
+def total(xs Vec) Int64 := :lists.sum(xs)
+#                          ^^^^^^ constant.other.symbol.rian
+
+range Letter := 'A'..'Z'
+#               ^^^ string.quoted.single.rian
+#                  ^^ keyword.operator.range.rian
+
+@wire(big_endian)
+# <- punctuation.definition.annotation.rian
+#^^^^ entity.name.decorator.rian
+
+def n(x Int64) Float64 := 1.5
+#                         ^^^ constant.numeric.float.rian
+
+def ord(p Shape) Shape := Point(x: 0, y: 1)
+#                               ^ entity.name.tag.rian
+
+def words(n Int64) Int64 := if n > 0 do 1 else 0 end
+#                           ^^ keyword.control.rian
+#                                ^ keyword.operator.comparison.rian
+#                                    ^^ keyword.control.rian
+#                                         ^^^^ keyword.control.rian
